note: TR "Gadarenon" against "Gerasenon" in P75, Vaticanus, D (also 8:37).

kjv: the multitude throng thee (Jesus) and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
mine: the crowds surround You (Jesus) and are pressing in on You!
note: TR adds "kai legeis, tis ho hapsamenos mou;" from Mark 5:31; absent from P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L.

kjv: that he (Jesus) would not command them (the demons) to go out into the deep
mine: not to command them (the demons) to depart into the abyss
note: abyssos is the underworld prison of demons (Rev 9:1, 20:3), not the sea ("the deep"), into which the pigs later plunge.
